name: City Builder
tagline: Lay roads, parks and houses square by square and build a little 3D town.
about: A calm city-building sandbox by Kenney: pick roads, pavements, parks and buildings, turn them the way you like and place them on the grid. Every piece costs money, there's no rush and no game over; your town saves itself so you can keep building later.
controls: Tap a square to build the piece shown top right. < and > pick the piece, TURN rotates it, DEL switches to removing (tap a square to clear it), NEW starts over. Drag to move around, pinch to zoom, twist two fingers to turn the view. PC: click, WASD, Q / E, R, Delete, mouse wheel.
credit: Starter Kit City Builder by Kenney (kenney.nl), github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-City-Builder. Code and art: MIT license. Added to Lab Arcade with touch controls, autosave and a back button.
